items.title: M6A Implement corpus index and deterministic seeds
items.context: Build versioned path heading hash indexing, structured Story identifier extraction, exact plus normalized variants, and byte-deterministic golden tests.
items.userSees: Identical Story and corpus inputs produce the same versioned seed and corpus-index artifacts.

happy.desc: Run the corpus-index and keyword-seed generators twice against the same Story and requirements corpus, then validate proofbound.corpus-index.v1 and proofbound.keyword-seeds.v1 -> both runs emit byte-identical, schema-valid artifacts whose paths, H1/H2 headings, sizes, hashes, exact identifiers, normalized variants, source types, refs, and weights match the checked-in golden fixtures; WHY: maps schema-tests, determinism-tests, and golden-fixtures to the user-visible promise of stable routing inputs

edge.desc: Vary filesystem enumeration order, locale/case, hyphen/underscore/slash/camelCase/acronym forms, empty optional fields, and unchanged file mtimes -> artifact bytes and ordering remain deterministic while original exact tokens are retained beside normalized variants and content changes alone update the appropriate hashes; WHY: proves determinism at real normalization and corpus-boundary conditions

adversarial.desc: Introduce duplicate aliases, traversal/symlink escape candidates, malformed Markdown headings, and a large irrelevant document -> unsafe paths are rejected, duplicates cannot perturb ordering or weights, the corpus remains constrained to configured requirements Markdown, and no document body enters a prompt; WHY: prevents a forged or hostile corpus from invalidating the golden schema/determinism guarantees

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke proves schema versions, byte determinism, exact and normalized identifiers, stable ordering, traversal rejection, bounded artifacts, no document-body serialization, secret handling and tamper rejection.

Focused smoke proves schema versions, byte determinism, exact and normalized identifiers, stable ordering, traversal rejection, bounded artifacts, no document-body serialization, secret handling and tamper rejection.

items.title: M6B Implement sanitized host proposal adapters
items.context: Add Codex CLI and Claude Code CLI primary proposers, conditional agy fallback, universal pre-egress sanitizer, bounded schema validation, and deterministic local fallback.
items.userSees: Host proposals add bounded semantic keywords without exposing secret values or blocking local routing during outages.

happy.desc: Invoke candidate routing with available Codex CLI and Claude Code CLI primary proposers and a fixture that triggers conditional Antigravity CLI fallback -> each adapter uses core/host-run, accepts only bounded schema-valid sanitized proposals with provider/prompt/seed provenance, and merges advisory terms without granting gate authority; WHY: maps adapter-tests to the visible semantic-enrichment behavior and canonical host policy

edge.desc: Simulate one and both primary hosts unavailable, timed out, quota-limited, malformed, oversized, or disagreeing -> failures are recorded, agy is used only under policy, proposal term/ambiguity/rationale budgets are enforced, and deterministic local routing still returns candidates without an automatic full scan; WHY: maps host-failure-tests to graceful local fallback

adversarial.desc: Place secret-like values in Story/checklist prose, backticks, paths/titles, config/error text, deterministic terms and sourceRef provenance, and return secret-like or prompt-injected host output -> the single non-bypassable pre-egress sanitizer sends names not values, hashes/omits sensitive provenance, skips uncertain calls, rejects unsafe output without persistence/ranking influence, and leakage fixtures observe zero secret bytes for Codex, Claude, and agy; WHY: maps egress-leakage-tests to the security boundary

verificationEvidence.note: Fake-host integration exercises independent Codex and Claude attempts, conditional agy fallback, quota classification, schema and term budgets, non-bypassable pre-egress sanitization, unsafe-call skipping, and secret-like output rejection.

items.title: M6C Implement bounded local search and deterministic ranker
items.context: Plan bounded queries, search filenames headings and bodies locally, score deterministically, deduplicate aliases, and surface cutoff ambiguity and negative controls.
items.userSees: Relevant specifications are ranked into a bounded candidate set with explicit reasons and escalation on ambiguity.

happy.desc: Route golden Story/spec pairs through filename, heading, exact-body, normalized, host-semantic, pair, and negative-control query stages -> the deterministic scorer ranks known relevant documents with versioned reasons/provenance, deduplicates aliases, and emits at most 8 ordinary full-read candidates from at most 10 query groups; WHY: maps ranker-tests and search-budget-tests to the bounded ranked-candidate user result

edge.desc: Run sparse, noisy/excessive, zero-hit, truncated-result, legacy-synonym, negative-control, host-disagreement, and rank-8/rank-9 tie fixtures -> low source-class coverage, cutoff ties, material truncation, missing high-confidence legacy hits, and disagreement produce explicit ambiguity signals and structured escalation rather than silent omission; WHY: maps ambiguity-fixtures across the documented retrieval boundaries

adversarial.desc: Add an irrelevant 5 MB Markdown file and adversarial high-frequency terms intended to flood results or manipulate scores -> per-query hit caps, deduplication, negative-control penalties and deterministic tie-breaking hold, prompt/full-read bytes remain bounded, and any ranking-affecting truncation escalates without serializing the corpus; WHY: proves hostile corpus noise cannot recreate token exhaustion or bypass ranking limits

items.title: M6D Implement signed candidate artifact and mechanical read evidence
items.context: Persist versioned candidateSpecSet and reviewer read artifacts, reconcile declared manifests with mechanical logs, bind digests and freshness, and fail closed on missing stale forged or mismatched evidence.
items.userSees: Review coverage claims are backed by current signed candidate and actual-read evidence rather than self-reported prose.

happy.desc: Generate candidateSpecSet and ReviewerReadEvidence for a reviewer that fully reads candidates and title-triages the remainder, then submit the declared manifest with matching mechanical events -> versioned artifacts are signed/hash-bound to Story inputs, corpus, prompts, candidates, current material/story-files hashes and content hashes, and the gate accepts the current evidence while showing actual-read coverage; WHY: maps artifact-contract-tests to auditable user-visible review proof

edge.desc: Mutate Story input, corpus content, candidate content, prompt digest, HEAD/material hash or storyFilesHash after routing -> the appropriate freshness consumer classifies the evidence stale, requires rerouting/re-attestation according to the canonical drift rules, and never silently reuses an obsolete digest; WHY: maps freshness-tests to correct evidence renewal

adversarial.desc: Submit missing, unsigned, wrong-writer, forged-signature, altered-digest, replayed, manifest-log mismatched, missing-declared-read, undeclared-full-read, or full-scan-without-reason evidence -> every gate-consumed path fails closed and reports the precise mismatch; WHY: maps forgery-tests and ensures prose or proposal output cannot counterfeit actual review coverage

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-pass-discard-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Candidate artifact digest, corpus digest and current material/story-files bindings validate together with the existing mechanically captured reviewer read-log and signed review-pass/finding paths.
Focused freshness fixtures reject changed candidate digest, missing artifact and stale materialHash while shadow remains explicitly non-authoritative.
Tampered candidate artifacts, mismatched digests and manifest/read-log discrepancies are rejected or surfaced as signed findings; scope signature verification no longer depends on ambient cwd.

items.title: M6E Integrate bounded routing into PLAN scope review
items.context: Route scope-plan review through CLI candidates while preserving corpus filename enumeration, open questions, full-scan escalation, and scope-check gate semantics.
items.userSees: PLAN review reads bounded relevant documents by default and records why any broad scan was required.

happy.desc: Dispatch a PLAN scope reviewer for a normal Story and save scope_check evidence -> candidate_spec_route supplies a current bounded candidate digest, the reviewer fully reads selected specs, title-triages the complete filename index, maps covered/excluded/gap/orphan/open-question outcomes, and the user sees why the bounded documents were chosen; WHY: maps plan-integration-tests and the quality-baseline to preserved scope semantics

edge.desc: Exercise zero candidates, weak source-class coverage, high-risk gate/process changes, host disagreement, tied cutoff, truncated search, unresolved filename/title relevance and corpus drift -> PLAN records open questions or a structured scanEscalationReason with attempted set, consumed budget, expanded scope and stop condition, then reroutes or tool-scans as required; WHY: maps scan-escalation-tests without weakening recall

adversarial.desc: Attempt scope_check_save in enforce mode with no/stale candidate artifact, proposal-only evidence, fabricated read prose, manifest mismatch, or an unexplained full scan -> PLAN fails closed and cannot pass the signed scope gate, while shadow/warn remain explicitly non-authoritative and no fallback embeds requirements bodies into _reviewPrompt; WHY: prevents routing and prompt-budget guard bypass

verificationEvidence.note: PLAN scope dispatch exposes the current bounded candidate and corpus digests, candidate reasons and digest-bearing readManifest without embedding document bodies.
Zero-hit, host-failure, disagreement/truncation and promotion fixtures preserve explicit ambiguity/escalation while deterministic local routing remains bounded.
Enforce binding rejects missing/mismatched/stale candidate evidence, shadow is explicitly non-authoritative, and PLAN prompt regression asserts no corpus body injection.

items.title: M6F Reuse routing evidence across REVIEW and delivery lanes
items.context: Share current candidate digest across eligible lanes, preserve reviewer ownership, reroute on diff or corpus drift, and suppress duplicate findings without weakening lane independence.
items.userSees: Behavior docs coverage and delivery reviewers reuse current routing evidence without overlapping authority or losing findings.

happy.desc: Run behavior, docs, coverage and delivery review fixtures against the same current Story/corpus/diff -> eligible lanes reuse the same candidate digest and read evidence, each lane records its own signed decision under its legal writer identity, delivery sees current transcripts/evidence, and load-bearing findings match the full-scan baseline without duplicates; WHY: maps review-lane-tests, delivery-tests and finding-equivalence

edge.desc: Change the Story diff, requirements corpus, doc promises, or candidate content between PLAN, REVIEW and delivery -> affected lanes detect freshness drift and reroute, unchanged lanes may reuse only contractually current evidence, and duplicate clustering suppresses repeated findings without suppressing distinct owner/category evidence; WHY: verifies freshness and deduplication at cross-phase boundaries

adversarial.desc: Have main or implementer evidence impersonate a reviewer, reuse a pass from another lane, replay a stale digest, or cluster two semantically distinct load-bearing findings -> reviewer-lane authority checks reject the overlap or replay, lane independence remains intact, and finding-equivalence reports any lost finding as a blocker; WHY: prevents shared routing from becoming shared authority or hiding review defects

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-pass-discard-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: REVIEW dispatch and delivery-context projection reuse the same current candidate/corpus digests while existing signed reviewer-run/pass paths preserve per-lane authority.
Candidate freshness binding detects digest/material drift; rollout equivalence fixtures block quality loss and require rerouting rather than silently reusing stale evidence.
Canonical review-run guards still reject cross-lane/implementer evidence; shared routing contributes context only and does not grant signing authority or suppress distinct findings.

items.title: M6G Implement shadow warn enforce rollout and rollback
items.context: Add canonical configuration, metrics, equivalence and recall gates, staged modes, process-fact contracts, and rollback to tool-driven broad review that never restores corpus prompt embedding.
items.userSees: Operators can progress from shadow to warn to enforce only after quality and cost thresholds pass, with a safe non-injection rollback.

happy.desc: Run two consecutive evaluation windows whose golden recall, finding equivalence, candidate/full-read bytes, latency, mismatch and escalation metrics meet the accepted thresholds -> canonical configuration permits shadow to warn to enforce promotion, process-fact/command-policy/registry/verifier contracts agree, and operators see the promotion evidence and active mode; WHY: maps rollout-tests, process-fact-contract and two-window-evaluation

At final delivery, collect provider-reported usage from every available Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI invocation and aggregate total input, output, and cache-read tokens without mixing categories -> the user receives provider totals by host plus the largest attributable milestone, host, and command cost with its evidence source; WHY: fulfills the explicit final token-consumption report using authoritative provider counters where available

edge.desc: Make either evaluation window miss critical/high recall, 98 percent overall recall, finding equivalence, prompt-byte, latency, budget, or zero-mismatch thresholds, and simulate host outage during each mode -> promotion is blocked with diagnostic metrics, shadow/warn preserve existing authority, enforce fails closed only where configured, and host failure still uses deterministic local routing; WHY: proves thresholds and staged failure semantics govern rollout

Generate a final usage report when one or more providers omit token counters, sessions overlap multiple milestones, or usage_sweep attributes shared cached input to more than one unit -> missing provider fields are shown as unavailable, usage_sweep numbers are presented separately as non-authoritative estimates, multi-attribution and shared-cache uncertainty are explicit, and no estimate is presented as exclusive task consumption; WHY: prevents false precision while still identifying the best-supported largest cost center

adversarial.desc: Attempt to force enforce through config drift, stale/forged evaluation evidence, missing process-fact registration, or rollback after enforcement -> contract verification rejects unauthorized promotion, rollback returns to explicit tool-driven broad review with recorded escalation, and regression guards prove recursive requirements reads, Truth Source concatenation, and corpus prompt embedding remain impossible; WHY: validates safe rollback and prevents the original 2 MB failure from returning

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.js && node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs
verificationEvidence.note: Two-window promotion passes only at 100% critical/high recall, >=98% overall recall, finding equivalence, >=90% byte reduction, latency and zero mismatch/full-scan violations; process-fact registry contract passes.
A failing second window reports every missed threshold and blocks enforce; deterministic host-outage fallback remains local and bounded.

Rollback is tool-driven broad review with recorded escalation and corpusPromptInjectionAllowed=false; regression measured 2,936 bytes unchanged after adding a large corpus and 99.91% reduction from the reconstructed pre-fix prompt.
